description: This file defines a Busy struct managing server busy state, including setting, clearing, and notifying cluster nodes about busy status changes, with JSON serialization support.

classes.name: Busy
classes.description: Represents the server's busy state, managing busy status, expiration, and cluster notifications.

methods.name: NewBusy
methods.description: Creates a new Busy instance with optional cluster interface for notifications.

methods.name: Busy.IsBusy
methods.description: Returns true if the server is marked as busy.

methods.name: Busy.Set
methods.description: Marks the server as busy for a specified duration and notifies cluster nodes.

methods.name: Busy.Clear
methods.description: Marks the server as not busy and notifies cluster nodes.

methods.name: Busy.Expires
methods.description: Returns the time when the server will no longer be marked as busy.

methods.name: Busy.ToJSON
methods.description: Serializes the busy state to JSON.

methods.name: Busy.ClusterEventChanged
methods.description: Handles cluster event to update busy state based on received message.
